text: A river carries water from high ground toward a lake or the sea. Rain changes its speed. People measure the water level at the same bridge each morning and record their observations in a notebook.
小河把山坡上的雨水带向湖泊。天气变化会影响水流速度。村里的观察员每天清晨来到同一座桥边，测量水位，再把日期和测量结果写进记录本。长期记录有助于发现季节变化。

The school garden has a sunny corner and a shaded corner. Students plant the same seeds in both places. They give each pot equal water, count new leaves every week, and compare the results before drawing a conclusion.
学校花园有向阳处，也有树荫。学生把同一种种子分别种在两个区域，给每盆植物相同的水量，每周数一次新长出的叶子。比较结果时，他们先检查记录是否完整，再讨论光照的影响。

The small library organizes books by subject. A visitor can search the catalog, read a short description, and borrow a book with a library card. Returning books on time allows more readers to use the same collection.
社区图书馆按主题摆放图书。读者可以查询目录，阅读简介，再使用借书卡办理借阅。按时归还图书能让更多人使用同一批资料。管理员会检查损坏情况，并定期整理书架和阅读区。

A useful experiment begins with a question and a measurable result. Change one factor at a time, keep a record of the conditions, and repeat the measurement. An unexpected result is information that deserves another careful check.
一次有用的实验从明确问题和可测量的结果开始。实验者每次只改变一个条件，记录其他条件，并重复测量。出现意外结果时，不应立即删除记录，而要检查设备、操作过程和可能遗漏的因素。

A passenger checks the departure board before boarding a train. The board lists the destination, platform, and expected departure time. If the service changes, the station announces an update so passengers can adjust their plans.
旅客在上车前查看出发信息牌，核对目的地、站台和预计发车时间。如果列车安排发生变化，车站会及时发布通知。提前检查行程并保留适当的换乘时间，可以减少出行中的不确定性。

A map uses symbols to show paths, buildings, and water. The legend explains each symbol. A scale connects a distance on paper to a distance on the ground, helping a walker estimate how long a route might take.
地图使用符号表示道路、建筑和水域，图例解释每种符号的含义。比例尺把纸上的距离与实际距离联系起来。出发前阅读图例并确认方向，能帮助步行者估计路程和所需时间。

A cook writes down the ingredients before preparing a meal. Measuring the same way each time makes a recipe easier to repeat. A clean work surface and clearly labeled containers help the cook find what is needed.
厨师在准备一顿饭之前列出所需食材。每次采用相同的计量方法，有助于复现食谱。保持操作台清洁，并在容器上清楚标注名称，能够减少寻找材料的时间，也方便其他人协作。

A weather observer measures temperature away from direct sunlight. The instrument is checked regularly. The observer records the time and location with each reading, because measurements from different conditions cannot always be compared directly.
气象观察员在避开阳光直射的位置测量气温，并定期检查仪器。每次读数都要附上时间和地点，因为不同条件下的测量不一定能够直接比较。完整记录比只记住一个数值更有用。
